metadata.description: Euclidean Condensate Theory (ECT) investigates status-separated routes from a four-dimensional Euclidean scalar condensate to conditional Lorentzian kinematics, quantum and open-system structures, and gravity-completion programmes. The preprint distinguishes results derived inside explicitly stated models (Level A), structural or closure-dependent results (Level B), phenomenological fits, imported benchmarks, and application diagnostics (Level C), and Open physical owners. A scalar characteristic cone is not by itself a physical clock, universal matter/photon/tensor metric, Born-measure owner, or completed tensor-gravity dynamics. Galactic and cosmological calculations retain their supplied response, metric, background, state, and data assumptions; reproduction of an external source model or agreement with data is not presented as an ECT-specific derivation. The repository provides auditable calculation, figure, and release provenance without upgrading scientific status.
metadata.title: Euclidean Condensate Theory (ECT): Conditional Routes from a Euclidean Condensate to Lorentzian Kinematics, Quantum Structures, and Gravity
